# README banner

`farmersdelight-banner.svg` combines generated wooden title artwork with the original
PaperMC and Folia images. The platform marks identify supported servers; they are
not this project's own logo and do not imply official endorsement.

The wooden base was generated with the built-in `image_gen` tool. Its final PNG is
`farmersdelight-banner-base.png`; the requests are recorded in
`farmersdelight-banner.prompt.txt`. The SVG only places the original images at their
original aspect ratios. It does not repaint their pixels, colors or transparency.

Platform artwork belongs to its respective owners; the plugin's AGPL license does
not grant additional rights over their marks. Sources were checked on 2026-10-04.
